headline: Angel One releases eight stock recommendations for Samvat 2083
hook: Brokerage picks for the new Samvat year
summary: Angel One has identified eight stocks for the upcoming Samvat 2083, projecting potential upsides of up to 32%. The list includes ICICI Bank, Northern Arc Capital, Aarti Pharmalabs, Shanti Gold International, Ratnaveer Precision Engineering, Engineers India, AGI Infra, and Apollo Micro Systems. These recommendations are timed for the traditional Muhurat trading session. Retail investors should note these are broker-specific research calls.
why_it_matters: Brokerage research may influence short-term price action for these specific stocks.

headline: Ratnaveer Precision shares rise 8 percent following strong second-quarter financial results
hook: Tripled in value since March lows
summary: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering reported healthy second-quarter earnings, driving an 8 percent surge in its stock price. The counter has now gained 200 percent from its March low. Retail investors holding the stock benefit from the sharp upward momentum backed by solid quarterly numbers.
why_it_matters: Strong quarterly performance drives sharp short-term gains for shareholders.

headline: Ratnaveer Precision jumps 8 percent following strong second-quarter performance
summary: Ratnaveer Precision shares surged 8 percent following healthy second-quarter earnings results. The stock has gained 154 percent so far in calendar year 2026, significantly outperforming the BSE Sensex which declined 11.7 percent over the same period. The counter has also risen 200 percent from its March low. Retail investors holding the stock benefit from strong momentum and outperformance against broader market indices.
why_it_matters: Strong momentum rewards existing shareholders amid broader market declines.
winners_losers: Ratnaveer Precision shareholders gain / market underperformers hurt

headline: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering posts 35 percent jump in Q2 revenue
hook: Strong revenue and profit growth reported
summary: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited announced its financial results for the quarter ending September 2026. The company reported a 35 percent year-on-year rise in revenue to Rs 3,872.37 million. Net profit surged 56 percent year-on-year to Rs 240.63 million for the same period. H1 FY27 figures also reflected similar growth momentum.
why_it_matters: Earnings growth validates fundamental health for existing shareholders.
